text: A slow, mostly lactic set gives a fragile, moist curd that is ladled with little cutting and left to drain by itself. Repeated washing with marc de Bourgogne water during at least four weeks develops the brick-red colour and pungent aroma of the rind.

steps.note: Mostly lactic; rennet is the only coagulant allowed.
Into cylinders of 95–115 mm (250–350 g) or 165–190 mm (700–1100 g).
Washed with water containing marc de Bourgogne.
